groups.intro:
Whether and how the state credentials this profession — the regulatory model,
credential type, issuing authority, entry requirements (education, exams, age,
character), fees, renewal, continuing education, and reciprocity.

fields.meaning: Whether the state requires a credential to practice this profession.

example.quote: A person practicing or offering to practice registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nursing in the state shall submit evidence of qualification to practice and shall be licensed under t

fields.meaning: Free-text name of the board/agency that issues the credential (the structured form is `regulatory_authority`).

example.quote: There is created a Board of Nursing, consisting of seven members appointed by the governor

fields.meaning: Structured decomposition of the issuing authority — name, type (standalone board / shared board / division / department / joint), and any umbrella agency it sits within. Populated alongside the legacy free-text issuing_authority for back-compat.
Canonical name of the immediate authority (e.g., 'State Board of Podiatry').

example.quote: There is created a Board of Nursing, consisting of seven members appointed by the governor

fields.meaning: Structural classification of the immediate authority.

example.quote: There is created a Board of Nursing, consisting of seven members appointed by the governor

fields.meaning: Higher-level agency that contains the immediate authority, if any. Example: 'Division of Occupations and Professions, Department of Commerce'. Null for standalone boards that don't sit inside a larger department.

example.value: Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development
example.quote: The Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development, in consultation with the board, shall employ a licensed registered nurse

fields.meaning: Minimum age (years) to hold the credential, if the statute sets one.

example.quote: A person who wishes to practice as a certified nursing assistant or a licensed nursing assistant shall be at least sixteen years of age.

fields.meaning: Whether the statute conditions licensure on good moral character / fitness.

example.quote: An applicant for a license to practice professional nursing as a registered nurse shall submit to the board written evidence of qualification, verified by oath, that such applicant is of good moral ch

fields.meaning: Education entry requirement — degree, level, accreditation, and any tiers.

example.value: Completion of an accredited registered nurse, practical nurse, or advanced practice registered nurse education program
example.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a registered nurse education program accredited by a national nursing accrediting body and approved by the board
a registered nurse education program accredited by a national nursing accrediting body and approved by the board

fields.meaning: The comparable education FLOOR as a normalized rung. Populate whenever licensure is gated on a degree; null only if the statute is silent on education.

example.quote: one member shall be a registered nurse engaged in nursing education at the associate, baccalaureate, or graduate degree level at an institution that holds national nursing accreditation

fields.meaning: How the statute decides a school counts. national_accreditor=a named national program accreditor (ACOE/CODA/ACEND/LCME/CPME). regional_accreditor='regionally accredited college or university'. board_approved='approved by the board' (discretionary state gate). unspecified=says 'accredited' with no basis named, or silent.

example.quote: a registered nurse education program accredited by a national nursing accrediting body and approved by the board

fields.meaning: True if the statute pegs the education requirement to a NATIONAL CREDENTIAL (e.g. 'registered by CDR', 'passed the NBEO') rather than (or in addition to) a stated degree — such a state inherits whatever that national body currently requires.

example.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a registered nurse education program accredited by a national nursing accrediting body and approved by the board

fields.meaning: Per-tier floors when the statute sets different education levels for different license classes, or phases the floor in by date. Omit/null when there is a single floor. `degree_level` still records the overall floor across all tiers.
Which class/date this floor applies to — e.g. 'licensed dietitian', 'certified nutritionist', 'applicants on or after 2024-01-01'.

Normalized education floor, low -> high. Resolved to the rung even when
the statute uses verbiage ('six college years' -> doctorate, 'or equivalent
degree' -> the named level). Professional/clinical doctorates (OD, DDS, MD,
DPM) are `doctorate`.
ISO date when this floor takes effect, for date-phased tiers (e.g. '2024-01-01'). Null otherwise.
Supervised practice / residency / apprenticeship required after the degree.

example.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a registered nurse education program accredited by a national nursing accrediting body and approved by the board

fields.meaning: ALWAYS populate (required_by_statute / embedded_in_credential / none) unless the governing statute is absent from the corpus. Disambiguates a blank `required`: 'none' (truly no requirement) vs 'embedded_in_credential' (the accredited degree the statute points to carries the supervised hours).

example.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a registered nurse education program accredited by a national nursing accrediting body and approved by the board

fields.meaning: e.g. '24 months', '1 year', '2,000 hours' (free text — units vary)

example.value: minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4,600 hours
example.quote: Has completed a transition to practice in California of a minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4600 hours.

fields.meaning: e.g. 'podiatric residency', 'accounting work experience', 'AXP'

example.value: transition to practice (for nurse practitioners seeking independent practice authority)
example.quote: "Transition to practice" means additional clinical experience and mentorship provided to prepare a nurse practitioner to practice independently.

fields.meaning: Examinations required for the credential (one entry per exam).

example.value: Registered Nursing or Practical Nursing Licensing Examination
Applies to RN and LPN applicants

fields.meaning: Where the exam is administered / who owns it — e.g. 'NBPME (national)', 'state board (in-state)', 'NCLEX-RN (national)'. Use the statute's language; null if the source doesn't say.
Max attempts allowed before re-qualification. Null if not specified.
How the credential is renewed — interval and any conditions.
Most states are 1 or 2

example.quote: Licenses shall be renewed biennially on the dates set by the department with the approval of the respective board.

fields.meaning: License renewal fee in US dollars (integer). Many statutes leave the amount to the board's discretion — leave null in that case.

example.quote: The board may impose a renewal fee in an amount not to exceed one hundred dollars ($100).

fields.meaning: Continuing-education requirement to keep the credential active.

example.quote: A license to practice nursing may not be renewed unless the nurse has complied with continuing competence requirements established by the board by regulation.
The board shall not require more than twenty (20) hours of continuing education per year
The board shall not require more than twenty (20) hours of continuing education per year

fields.meaning: Specific topical CE requirements, e.g. ['1.5 hrs opioid', 'ethics']

value: pain management and opioid use and addiction (minimum 2 hours, for APRNs with DEA registration numbers)
example.quote: The regulations must require that a licensee receive not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a lic

fields.meaning: Whether/how the state recognizes out-of-state credentials (endorsement/reciprocity).

example.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to practice as a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse, whichever is appropriate, to an applicant who has worked as a nurse within t

fields.meaning: Free-form summary

example.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state, meet AK qualifications under AS 08.68.170, and have worked as a nurse within the past five years; or if not worked within five years, must also meet continuing competency requirements or complete a board-approved course of study.
example.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to practice as a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse, whichever is appropriate, to an applicant who has worked as a nurse within t

fields.meaning: Profession-specific advisory body sitting alongside the main licensing board, when one exists. Populated for states that delegate licensure to a generic board and add a specialty advisory committee.
True if a profession-specific advisory body exists alongside the main licensing board. False if the licensing board itself is profession-specific (no separate advisory body needed).

example.quote: There is created a Board of Nursing, consisting of seven members appointed by the governor

fields.meaning: Name of the advisory board, e.g. 'Podiatry Advisory Committee'.

example.quote: The Prescriptive Authority Advisory Committee is created as an advisory committee to the Arkansas State Board of Nursing

fields.meaning: Authority the advisory board has, in the statute's own words — e.g. 'advisory only', 'rulemaking subject to board approval', 'disciplinary recommendations'. Free text from the statute.

example.value: advisory — assists the board in implementing provisions regarding prescriptive authority
example.quote: The committee shall assist the board in implementing the provisions of this chapter regarding prescriptive authority

fields.meaning: Name of a national CERTIFICATION the state recognizes or requires, e.g. 'American Board of Podiatric Surgery (ABPS)' or 'National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME)'. The certifying body, NOT the association. Null if the statute doesn't reference one.

example.value: National certifying body recognized by the Arkansas State Board of Nursing (role-specific, e.g., for CRNA: Council on Accreditation of Nurse Anesthesia Educational Programs)
example.quote: Hold current certification by a national certifying body recognized by the board in the advanced practice registered nurse role and population foci appropriate to educational preparation

fields.meaning: Professional ASSOCIATION the state references (e.g. for accreditation or CE provider approval) — 'American Podiatric Medical Association (APMA)', 'American Dental Association (ADA)'. Distinct from the certifying body. Null if not referenced.

example.quote: The Governor shall appoint the seven members of the board who are licensed professional nurses, including the one licensed professional nurse who is approved to engage in advanced practice nursing in

fields.meaning: Which UORF model the state applies to this profession (license / mandatory_cert / registration / etc).

example.quote: A person practicing or offering to practice registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nursing in the state shall submit evidence of qualification to practice and shall be licensed under t

fields.meaning: What SHAPE of credential does the state issue, independent of whether holding it is mandatory? license / certification / registration / exemption / none. Pairs with is_mandatory to decompose the legacy regulatory_model rung.

example.quote: A person practicing or offering to practice registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nursing in the state shall submit evidence of qualification to practice and shall be licensed under t

fields.meaning: Is the credential MANDATORY to practice (or claim the title) in this state? True if practicing without it is prohibited; False if optional (e.g., voluntary certification that only protects the title for those who hold it).

example.quote: practice or offer to practice nursing without a license, unless the person is practicing within the scope of a delegation properly made under AS 08.68.805 or is giving necessary aid to the ill, injure

fields.meaning: Does the state restrict use of the profession's title to licensees? True if unlicensed people may NOT call themselves the protected title (e.g. 'podiatrist', 'CPA').

example.quote: use in connection with the person's name a designation that implies that the person is a licensed nurse unless the person is licensed

fields.meaning: Does the state restrict practice of the profession's scope to licensees? True if performing the scope without a license is prohibited (independent of title use).

example.quote: practice or offer to practice nursing without a license, unless the person is practicing within the scope of a delegation properly made under AS 08.68.805 or is giving necessary aid to the ill, injure

fields.meaning: Grounds on which the board may discipline a licensee. Typical statutes list 5-15.
snake_case key, e.g. 'fraud_in_obtaining_license'
One-line plain-English description

example.value: Obtained or attempted to obtain a nursing license by fraud or deceit

fields.meaning: Non-credential regulatory mechanisms (bonding, insurance, establishment regulation) imposed by the state. Obama 2015 framework typology. Independent of credential_type.
Does the statute require the practitioner or firm to post a bond (funds against which consumer claims can be made)? Independent of whether a credential is also required.

example.quote: The board is authorized to promulgate regulations requiring advanced practice nurses to have professional malpractice liability insurance or a suitable bond or other indemnity against liability for pr

fields.meaning: Does the statute require the practitioner or firm to carry insurance (e.g., professional liability, surety insurance)?

example.quote: A nurse practitioner practicing under this section shall have professional liability insurance appropriate for the practice setting.

fields.meaning: Does the statute regulate the ESTABLISHMENT / FIRM (e.g., facility license, mandatory inspection of premises) as a route to consumer protection, independent of any practitioner credential?

example.quote: No person may establish, operate, maintain, or advertise as a nurse agency in the State of Illinois unless the person is licensed under this Act by the Department of Labor.

fields.meaning: Statutory citations supporting the licensure fields above.

groups.intro:
What the practice act lets (or reserves to) this profession — the defined scope,
authorized methods, drug authority, and any title/scope protection. Skeleton only —
profession-specific scope richness lives in the discovered block.

fields.meaning: Verbatim statutory definition; quote field repeats the value text.

example.value: practice of registered nursing means the performance for compensation or personal profit of acts of professional service that requires substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the principles of biological, physiological, behavioral, and sociological sciences in assessing and responding to the health needs of individuals, families, or communities
example.quote: "practice of registered nursing" means the performance for compensation or personal profit of acts of professional service that requires substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on

fields.meaning: High-level methods, e.g. ['medical','surgical','mechanical']

value: assessment of problems, counseling, and teaching clients to maintain health or prevent illness and in care of ill, injured, or infirm
administration, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice
execution of a medical regimen as prescribed by a person authorized to practice medicine
performance of acts of medical diagnosis and prescription of medical therapeutic or corrective measures under board regulations (RN)
acts of medical diagnosis and prescription and dispensing of medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures (APRN)
example.quote: assessment of problems, counseling, and teaching ... administration, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice ... teaching others the skills of nursing ... execution of a medical re

fields.meaning: Whether/how the profession may prescribe, administer, or dispense drugs.

example.value: Advanced practice registered nurses may prescribe and dispense medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures under board regulations, subject to opioid prescribing limits and DEA registration requirements for controlled substances.
example.quote: "advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered nurse licensed to practice in the state who, because of specialized education and experience, is certified to perform acts of medical diagnosis

groups.intro: Fields discovered specifically for this profession (auto-derived from its statutes); they vary profession to profession.

fields.meaning: The distinct license or certification tiers recognized in the state, each with its own scope and requirements.

value: advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) — including certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA), certified clinical nurse specialist (CNS), certified nurse practitioner (CNP), certified nurse midwife (CNM)
example.quote: A person practicing or offering to practice registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nursing in the state shall submit evidence of qualification to practice and shall be licensed under t

fields.meaning: The recognized advanced practice registered nurse role categories, each with distinct scope and certification requirements.

example.quote: requirements for an advanced practice registered nurse to practice as a certified registered nurse anesthetist, certified clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse practitioner, or certified nurse mi

fields.meaning: The categories of licensed professionals under whose supervision a practical or vocational nurse must work.

example.quote: A practical nurse shall work under the supervision of a licensed registered or advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed physician, a licensed physician assistant, or a licensed dentist.

fields.meaning: Whether certain advanced practice nurses (typically NPs and CNMs) must have a written collaborative practice agreement with a physician to practice or prescribe.

example.quote: Certified registered nurse practitioners and certified nurse midwives are subject to collaborative practice agreements with an Alabama physician.

fields.meaning: Whether the state provides a pathway for certain APRNs to practice fully independently without a physician collaboration or supervision requirement.

example.quote: No person may practice as a certified registered nurse practitioner or a certified nurse midwife in this state unless that person possesses a certificate of qualification issued by the Board of Nursin

fields.meaning: Number of supervised or collaborative practice hours required before an APRN may qualify for full independent practice authority.

example.quote: Proof of successful completion of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) hours of practice

fields.meaning: Whether APRNs must obtain a separate board-issued certificate or number to prescribe or furnish drugs, beyond the basic APRN license.

example.quote: The Board of Nursing shall recognize the educational qualifications and training of advanced practice nurses by the issuance of a certification of qualification to engage in advanced practice nursing.

fields.meaning: The DEA controlled substance schedules that APRNs are authorized to prescribe, which may differ by role or state.

value: Schedule II (CRNA during perioperative/peri-obstetrical/medical procedure period)
example.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse's prescriptive authority shall extend only to drugs listed in Schedules III - V and...also extends to drugs listed in Schedule II if: (i) The prescription is for

fields.meaning: Statutory limits on opioid prescriptions issued by APRNs, including maximum day-supply and documentation requirements.

example.value: An advanced practice registered nurse may not issue an initial prescription for an opioid exceeding a seven-day supply to an adult for outpatient use, or any opioid prescription exceeding seven days to a minor; exceptions exist for chronic pain, cancer, palliative care, or logistical/travel barriers.
example.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may not issue (1) an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use; (2) a prescription for an opioid t

fields.meaning: Whether APRNs authorized to prescribe controlled substances must register with the federal DEA.

fields.meaning: Whether APRNs with DEA numbers must register with the state's controlled substance prescription monitoring database.

fields.meaning: Whether the state board maintains a registry of certified nurse aides, including disciplinary findings.

example.quote: The board shall maintain a registry of certified nurse aides.

fields.meaning: Whether the state has a separate certification category for medication assistants or medication assistive persons who may administer certain medications under nurse supervision.

example.quote: Adopt and revise rules providing standards including, but not limited to, scope of practice for certified medication assistants and the issuance of certified medication assistant permits by the board

fields.meaning: Whether licensed nurses are explicitly authorized by statute to delegate nursing tasks to unlicensed assistive personnel under defined conditions.

example.quote: An employer may not discharge, threaten, or otherwise discriminate against a nurse employed by the employer regarding the nurse's compensation, terms, conditions, location, or privileges of employment

fields.meaning: Whether the state has enacted the Enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact (eNLC), allowing multistate licensure privileges.

example.quote: An applicant for a license to practice professional nursing in Alabama may apply for either a single state license or a multistate license.

fields.meaning: Whether the state has a voluntary non-disciplinary alternative or diversion program for nurses impaired by substance use or mental health conditions.

example.quote: A registered nurse licensed under this chapter may make a determination and pronouncement of death of a person

fields.meaning: Whether the state has a separate board-issued public health nurse certification with title protection.

fields.meaning: Statutory rules governing when an APRN may prescribe or treat without a prior in-person physical examination, including telehealth or internet-based restrictions.

example.value: An APRN may render a diagnosis, provide treatment, or prescribe/dispense/administer a non-controlled prescription drug without a physical examination if follow-up care is available and records are sent to the primary care provider with patient consent. Controlled substances may also be prescribed under the same conditions. However, an APRN may not prescribe in response to an Internet questionnaire or email to a person without a prior provider-patient relationship.

example.quote: Proof of successful completion of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) hours of practice

fields.meaning: The statutory model governing the relationship between a CRNA and a physician during anesthesia administration.

example.quote: functions under the direction of or in coordination with a physician licensed to practice medicine, a podiatrist, or a dentist, who is immediately available.

fields.meaning: Whether certified nurse midwives are explicitly authorized to attend births in out-of-hospital settings.
